practiceQuestions.q: Which article of the Indian Constitution provides for the office of the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha?
practiceQuestions.sol: Article 89(1) of the Indian Constitution explicitly states that the Rajya Sabha shall, as soon as may be, choose a member of the House to be Deputy Chairman thereof. Article 89(2) deals with vacating and filling vacancies.

practiceQuestions.q: Who elects the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha?
opts: Only the elected members of the Lok Sabha
Members of the Rajya Sabha from amongst themselves
The President of India on the recommendation of the Prime Minister
practiceQuestions.sol: The Deputy Chairman is chosen by the Rajya Sabha from amongst its own members whenever a vacancy occurs in the office.

practiceQuestions.q: To whom does the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha submit their resignation?
opts: The Chairman of the Rajya Sabha
The Secretary-General of the Rajya Sabha
practiceQuestions.sol: Under Article 90(b) of the Constitution, the Deputy Chairman resigns their office by writing under their hand addressed to the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.

practiceQuestions.q: What is the normal term of office for the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha?
opts: As long as they remain a member of the Rajya Sabha
practiceQuestions.sol: The Deputy Chairman holds office until they cease to be a member of the Rajya Sabha, provided their term is normally 6 years as a member, but the office of Deputy Chairman itself is not fixed to a 5-year term like Lok Sabha.

practiceQuestions.q: Under which Article can the Deputy Chairman be removed from office by a resolution of the Rajya Sabha passed by a majority of all the then members?
practiceQuestions.sol: Article 90(c) states that a Deputy Chairman may be removed from office by a resolution of the Council passed by a majority of all the then members of the Council (effective majority).

practiceQuestions.q: When does the Deputy Chairman preside over the Rajya Sabha?
opts: Only when the Lok Sabha is dissolved
When the Chairman is absent or discharging the functions of the President
At all times during joint sittings of Parliament
practiceQuestions.sol: The Deputy Chairman performs the duties of the Chairman when the office of Chairman is vacant or when the Vice-President is acting as or discharging the functions of the President, or during the absence of the Chairman from any sitting.

practiceQuestions.q: Who was the first Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha?
opts: S. V. Krishnamoorthy Rao (Wait, S.V. Krishnamoorthy Rao was second; first was S.N. Mukherjee / S.V. Krishnamoorthy Rao? Let's check S.V. Krishnamoorthy Rao)
practiceQuestions.sol: S. V. Krishnamoorthy Rao served as the first Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha, elected on May 31, 1952.

practiceQuestions.q: Can a resolution for the removal of the Deputy Chairman be moved without prior notice?
opts: Yes, with the permission of the Prime Minister
No, at least 14 days' notice must be given
practiceQuestions.sol: According to the rules of procedure of the Rajya Sabha, a resolution for the removal of the Deputy Chairman requires a clear prior notice of at least 14 days.

practiceQuestions.q: Who nominates a panel of Vice-Chairpersons to preside over the Rajya Sabha in the absence of both the Chairman and the Deputy Chairman?
opts: The Chairman of the Rajya Sabha
practiceQuestions.sol: Under the Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in the Council of States, the Chairman nominates from amongst the members a panel of Vice-Chairpersons.

practiceQuestions.q: When the Deputy Chairman is presiding over the Rajya Sabha, does he/she have a right to vote in the first instance?
opts: No, he/she can only exercise a casting vote (tie-breaking vote)
Yes, but only on Money Bills
He/she has no voting rights under any circumstances
practiceQuestions.sol: While presiding, the Chairman or the Deputy Chairman does not vote in the first instance; they exercise a casting vote only in the case of a tie (equal votes).

practiceQuestions.q: Why is the position of the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha distinct from that of the Chairman in terms of institutional dependence?
opts: The Chairman is a member of the House, whereas the Deputy Chairman is not.
The Chairman is an external functionary (Vice-President), while the Deputy Chairman is an internal member chosen from within the House.
The Deputy Chairman holds executive veto powers over state legislation unlike the Chairman.
There is no functional difference; both are appointed by the executive.
practiceQuestions.sol: The Chairman of the Rajya Sabha is the Vice-President of India, who is an ex-officio officer and not a member of the House. Conversely, the Deputy Chairman is elected from amongst the members of the Rajya Sabha, reflecting internal parliamentary democracy.

practiceQuestions.q: How does the removal process of the Deputy Chairman safeguard the independence of the office?
opts: By requiring the concurrence of the Lok Sabha before initiation
By requiring an absolute/effective majority of the Rajya Sabha and preventing arbitrary executive dismissal
By permitting removal only through the Supreme Court collegium
By making the office non-removable once elected
practiceQuestions.sol: The Deputy Chairman cannot be removed at the whims of the executive or the Chairman. Removal requires a formal resolution passed by a special/effective majority (majority of all the then members) of the Rajya Sabha after 14 days' notice, ensuring stability and independence.

practiceQuestions.q: Consider the scenario where both the Chairman and Deputy Chairman's offices fall vacant simultaneously. What constitutional mechanism is activated?
opts: The President appoints a temporary Speaker from the Lok Sabha.
A member of the panel of Vice-Chairpersons nominated by the President or the House presides, and elections are held to fill the vacancies.
The Prime Minister automatically takes over the chairmanship.
Parliamentary proceedings are suspended indefinitely until the Vice-President is elected.
practiceQuestions.sol: Under Article 91(1), if the office of the Chairman is vacant or the Vice-President is acting as President, and the Deputy Chairman's office is also vacant, the duties of the office shall be performed by such member of the Rajya Sabha as the President may appoint, or members from the panel of Vice-Chairpersons under rules.

practiceQuestions.q: What is the constitutional significance of Article 92 with respect to the Deputy Chairman?
opts: It empowers the Deputy Chairman to dissolve the Rajya Sabha.
It prohibits the Chairman or Deputy Chairman from presiding while a resolution for their removal from office is under consideration.
It grants dual voting rights to the Deputy Chairman during budget sessions.
It fixes the salary and allowances of the Deputy Chairman out of the Consolidated Fund of India.
practiceQuestions.sol: Article 92 expressly provides that the Chairman or the Deputy Chairman shall not preside while a resolution for their removal from office is under consideration, ensuring impartiality and natural justice.

practiceQuestions.q: In terms of administrative hierarchy and parliamentary precedence, how does the Deputy Chairman rank?
opts: Equal to Cabinet Ministers in the Table of Precedence
Equal to the Chief Justice of India
practiceQuestions.sol: In the Government of India's Table of Precedence, the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha is ranked at Article 7A, alongside Union Cabinet Ministers.

practiceQuestions.q: Can the Deputy Chairman participate in discussions and vote when a resolution for their own removal is being debated in the Rajya Sabha?
opts: They cannot attend the House at all during the debate.
They have the right to speak and take part in proceedings, and vote as a member (except casting vote), but cannot preside.
They have absolute veto power over the removal motion.
They can vote twice to save their position.
practiceQuestions.sol: Under Article 92(2), the Deputy Chairman has the right to speak in and otherwise to take part in the proceedings of the Council while a resolution for their removal is under consideration, and shall be entitled to vote in the first instance as a member, though not as presiding officer.

practiceQuestions.q: What happens to the Deputy Chairman's membership of the Rajya Sabha if the 6-year term expires mid-term of holding the office of Deputy Chairman?
opts: They automatically get a 3-year extension as Deputy Chairman.
They continue as Deputy Chairman until the next Lok Sabha elections.
They immediately vacate the office of Deputy Chairman as they cease to be a member of the Rajya Sabha.
They become the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.
practiceQuestions.sol: A fundamental prerequisite for being the Deputy Chairman is being a member of the Rajya Sabha. The moment their membership ends (e.g., retirement upon term expiry), they vacate the office of Deputy Chairman.

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following bodies or committees does the Deputy Chairman typically head or become a member of by virtue of office?
opts: Various Parliamentary Committees of Rajya Sabha such as the Committee on Subordinate Legislation, when appointed as member/chair.
The Monetary Policy Committee of RBI
practiceQuestions.sol: The Deputy Chairman is often appointed as a member or chairman of various parliamentary committees (such as the Business Advisory Committee or General Purposes Committee of Rajya Sabha where the Chairman is ex-officio chair, and Deputy Chairman is a key member).

practiceQuestions.q: In parliamentary practice, how is the election of the Deputy Chairman conducted?
opts: Through secret ballot by the Election Commission of India
By a motion moved in the House and adopted by a majority of members present and voting
Unanimous voice vote mandated by the Prime Minister
Appointment by the Supreme Court collegium
practiceQuestions.sol: The election of the Deputy Chairman is conducted in the Rajya Sabha by moving motions. Members propose candidates, and the House adopts the motion choosing the Deputy Chairman by a majority of members present and voting.

practiceQuestions.q: What distinguishes the panel of Vice-Chairpersons from the Deputy Chairman?
opts: The panel members are appointed by the President, whereas the Deputy Chairman is elected by the House.
Panel members cannot preside when both the Chairman and Deputy Chairman are absent.

The Deputy Chairman is an elected constitutional officer holding a permanent office until vacancy, whereas the panel is a nominated pool of members to preside only in the absence of both principal officers.
Panel members enjoy cabinet rank, while the Deputy Chairman does not.
practiceQuestions.sol: The Deputy Chairman is a constitutional officer elected under Article 89, whereas the panel of Vice-Chairpersons is nominated by the Chairman under the Rules of Procedure to act as presiding officers when both the Chairman and Deputy Chairman are absent.

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha:
1. The office of the Deputy Chairman is explicitly created by Article 89 of the Constitution of India.
2. The Deputy Chairman is subordinate to the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha in administrative hierarchy.
3. The Deputy Chairman can be removed from office by a resolution passed by the Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha in a joint sitting.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is correct: Article 89(1) provides for the Deputy Chairman. Statement 2 is correct: The Chairman is the head of the Rajya Sabha, making the Deputy Chairman second in the presiding hierarchy. Statement 3 is incorrect: The Deputy Chairman is removed by a resolution of the Rajya Sabha alone (passed by a majority of all the then members), not by a joint sitting.

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the powers and functions of the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha:
1. When presiding over the Rajya Sabha, the Deputy Chairman has the same powers as the Chairman.
2. The Deputy Chairman can vote on any bill or motion in the first instance like any ordinary member when not presiding.
3. The Deputy Chairman enjoys a casting vote in the case of a tie even when acting as a regular member of the House.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is correct: While presiding, the Deputy Chairman exercises the same powers as the Chairman. Statement 2 is correct: When not presiding, the Deputy Chairman functions as a regular member of the Rajya Sabha with normal voting rights. Statement 3 is incorrect: The casting vote can only be exercised by the person *presiding* over the session to break a tie, not by a member sitting on the floor of the House.

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the vacancy and removal of the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha:
1. The office of the Deputy Chairman falls vacant if they cease to be a member of the Rajya Sabha.
2. A resolution for the removal of the Deputy Chairman can be moved without giving any prior notice to the Secretariat.
3. Article 92 prevents the Deputy Chairman from presiding over the House when a resolution for their own removal is under consideration.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Statement 2 is incorrect because moving a removal resolution requires a mandatory prior notice of at least 14 days.

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the relationship between the Chairman and Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha:
1. The Deputy Chairman is subordinate to the Chairman, but does not receive orders from the Chairman in the discharge of constitutional duties.
2. Both the Chairman and Deputy Chairman receive their salaries and allowances charged upon the Consolidated Fund of India.
3. The Deputy Chairman automatically succeeds the Chairman upon the completion of the Chairman's term.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is correct: The Deputy Chairman presides independently under constitutional authority. Statement 2 is correct: Salaries of both the Chairman (as Vice-President) and Deputy Chairman are charged on the Consolidated Fund of India (Article 97). Statement 3 is incorrect: The Deputy Chairman does not automatically become the Chairman; the Vice-President of India is elected separately to be the ex-officio Chairman.

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the constitutional provisions governing the Deputy Chairman:
1. Article 90 deals with the vacation, resignation, and removal from office of the Deputy Chairman.
2. Article 91 outlines the power of the Deputy Chairman or other persons to perform the duties of the office of, or to act as, Chairman.
3. Article 93 provides for the election of the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Statements 1 and 2 are correct (Articles 90 and 91 respectively). Statement 3 is incorrect: Article 93 provides for the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the *Lok Sabha*, whereas the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha is provided under Article 89.

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the panel of Vice-Chairpersons in the Rajya Sabha:
1. The panel is nominated by the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha from amongst the members of the House.
2. Any member of the panel can preside over the House even when the Deputy Chairman is present and able to preside.
3. A member of the panel of Vice-Chairpersons cannot preside over the Rajya Sabha if both the offices of the Chairman and Deputy Chairman are vacant.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is correct: The Chairman nominates the panel. Statement 2 is incorrect: A member of the panel can preside only when *both* the Chairman and Deputy Chairman are absent. Statement 3 is incorrect: Under rules and Article 91, when both offices are vacant, members of the panel or designated persons perform duties until an election is held.

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the voting rights and participation of the Deputy Chairman:
1. The Deputy Chairman can participate in all debates and discussions of the House as a member.
2. When a resolution for the removal of the Deputy Chairman is under consideration, they are barred from participating in the debate.
3. The Deputy Chairman does not lose membership of committees of the House merely by virtue of holding the office of Deputy Chairman.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is correct: As a member, they participate in debates. Statement 2 is incorrect: Article 92(2) explicitly gives them the right to speak and take part in proceedings when their removal is under discussion. Statement 3 is correct: Holding office does not disqualify them from committee memberships.

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding parliamentary privileges and immunities of the Deputy Chairman:
1. The Deputy Chairman enjoys immunity from legal proceedings for anything said or any vote given in Parliament, similar to other MPs.
2. The salary and allowances of the Deputy Chairman are subject to annual vote of the Parliament.
3. The Deputy Chairman cannot be arrested in civil cases during the continuance of a session of Parliament and 40 days before and after such session.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is correct (Article 105). Statement 2 is incorrect because the salaries and allowances of the Chairman and Deputy Chairman are *charged* upon the Consolidated Fund of India and are *not* subject to vote of Parliament (Article 97). Statement 3 is correct regarding civil arrest immunity for MPs.

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements comparing the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha and the Deputy Speaker of the Lok Sabha:
1. Both officers are constitutionally mandated under Articles of the Indian Constitution.
2. Both are elected by their respective Houses from amongst their members.
3. Unlike the Deputy Speaker of the Lok Sabha, the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha is mandatorily chosen from the ruling party by convention.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is correct: Deputy Chairman is under Article 89, and Deputy Speaker under Article 93. Statement 2 is correct: Both are elected internally by their respective houses. Statement 3 is incorrect: Historically, the Deputy Speaker of Lok Sabha was sometimes from the opposition by convention, but there is no such mandatory constitutional rule for either, and Rajya Sabha Deputy Chairmen have also frequently belonged to various parties including opposition or alliance partners.

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding historical and procedural aspects of the Rajya Sabha Deputy Chairman:
1. The first Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha assumed office in 1952.
2. The Deputy Chairman has no say in certifying whether a Bill is a Money Bill, as that power rests exclusively with the Speaker of the Lok Sabha.
3. If the Rajya Sabha is dissolved, the Deputy Chairman immediately vacates office along with all other members.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is correct: S. V. Krishnamoorthy Rao took office in May 1952. Statement 2 is correct: Under Article 110, the certification of a Money Bill is exclusively done by the Speaker of the Lok Sabha. Statement 3 is incorrect: The Rajya Sabha is a permanent body and is **not subject to dissolution**; hence the premise of its dissolution is wrong.
